title.en: Nodes and a Walk Along the List

blurb.en: Three nodes, each holding a value and a reference to the next one, joined by hand - then a loop that follows the references from the head until they run out.
blurb.zh: 三个节点，每个装一个值、外加一个指向下一个节点的引用，手工连起来——再用一个循环从头顺着引用走，直到走不下去。

en: A linked list is a chain of small objects called nodes. Each node holds one value and one reference, next, to the node after it. The last node's next is None, which is how a walk along the list knows it has reached the end. The list as a whole is known only by its first node, the head: from the head you can reach everything else, and without it you can reach nothing.

Nothing links the three nodes until the main block does it. Node("ant") on its own is a node on its own; the two assignments to next are what turn three separate objects into one chain, and head = a just gives the front of the chain the name the functions expect.

length and show use the same walk: start a variable called current at the head, do something with the node it refers to, then move current on to that node's next. When current becomes None the walk is over. An empty list is just a head of None - the loop body never runs, so the length comes out as 0 without any special case.
zh: 链表是一串叫作节点的小对象。每个节点装一个值，外加一个引用 next，指向它后面的那个节点。最后一个节点的 next 是 None，沿着链表走的时候就靠它知道到头了。整条链表只靠第一个节点——头（head）——来认：从头出发能到达其余每一个节点，没有头就哪儿也去不了。
在主程序动手之前，这三个节点之间没有任何联系。Node("ant") 单独造出来就只是孤零零一个节点；是那两次给 next 赋值，把三个各自独立的对象变成了一条链，而 head = a 只是给链的最前端起一个函数们认的名字。
length 与 show 用的是同一种走法：让一个叫 current 的变量从头开始，处理它指着的那个节点，再让 current 换成那个节点的 next。current 变成 None，就走完了。空链表就是一个为 None 的头——循环体一次也不执行，长度自然是 0，不用单独处理。

lineNotes.en: The arrows are only decoration for printing. The real links are the next attributes - there is no arrow stored anywhere.
lineNotes.zh: 箭头只是打印时的装饰。真正的连接是各节点的 next 属性——哪里都没有存着一个箭头。

lineNotes.en: Two steps along the chain in one expression: head is the ant node, head.next is the bee node, and .value is what bee holds.
lineNotes.zh: 一个表达式里沿着链走两步：head 是 ant 节点，head.next 是 bee 节点，.value 是 bee 装着的值。

lineNotes.en: An empty list is simply no head at all. The walk handles it with no extra code.
lineNotes.zh: 空链表就是根本没有头。走链表的那段代码不加一行就能处理它。

blurb.en: Putting a new node into the middle of a chain takes two pointer changes, and they have to happen in the right order.
blurb.zh: 往链的中间放进一个新节点，要改两根指针，而且先后顺序不能乱。

en: Position 0 is a special case, because there is no node in front of the new one: the new node points at the old head, and the function hands the new node back so that the caller can use it as the head from now on. That is why apply_inserts writes head = insert_at(...) every time - most calls return the same head, but an insert at the front changes it. An empty list takes the same route, whatever i is.

Anywhere else, the loop walks prev forward until it sits on the node just before position i. Two links then change: the new node must point at the node that used to follow prev, and prev must point at the new node. The order matters. Change prev first and the only reference to the rest of the chain has just been overwritten - the new node is left pointing at itself and everything after it is lost.

An index past the end puts the value at the end: the loop stops early when prev has no next node. That is the same rule as Python's list.insert, which also appends when the index is too large. Negative indexes are not handled here.
zh: 位置 0 是特例，因为新节点前面没有节点：新节点指向原来的头，函数把新节点交回去，调用者从此拿它当头。所以 apply_inserts 每次都写 head = insert_at(...)——大多数调用交回的还是原来那个头，但往最前面插入会换掉它。空链表不管 i 是多少，也走这条路。
其他位置，循环让 prev 往前走，直到停在第 i 个位置前面那个节点上。然后改两根指针：新节点要指向原来跟在 prev 后面的那个节点，prev 要指向新节点。顺序要紧。先改 prev，指向后半条链的唯一引用就被覆盖了——新节点最后指着自己，后面的节点全部丢失。
下标超过末尾时，值放到最后：prev 没有下一个节点时循环提前停下。这和 Python 的 list.insert 是同一个规则——下标太大时它也是追加到末尾。这里不处理负下标。

lineNotes.en: prev starts on the node at position 0, so i - 1 steps bring it to position i - 1: the node just before where the new one goes.
lineNotes.zh: prev 从位置 0 的节点出发，走 i - 1 步就到了位置 i - 1：新节点要放的位置前面那个节点。

lineNotes.en: Out of nodes before reaching position i - 1: the index is past the end, so the new node goes after the last node.
lineNotes.zh: 还没走到位置 i - 1 节点就用完了：下标超出了末尾，于是新节点接在最后一个节点后面。

lineNotes.en: Always take the head back from insert_at. Forget the assignment and an insert at position 0 would vanish.
lineNotes.zh: 每次都从 insert_at 拿回头。漏了这个赋值，在位置 0 的插入就会凭空消失。

blurb.en: To take a node out of a chain you need the node before it - so a second pointer follows one step behind the first.
blurb.zh: 要从链里拿掉一个节点，得先抓住它前面那个节点——所以第二个指针总跟在第一个后面一步。

en: A node cannot unlink itself: it has no reference to the node in front of it. Deleting current means changing the next of the node before current so that it skips over current. So the walk keeps two variables, prev and current, with prev always one node behind. At the start there is no node behind, and prev is None.

If the match is the very first node, prev is still None and there is nothing to change - the head itself goes. The function returns the node after it as the new head, which is None when the list had only one node. Otherwise prev's link skips over current, and the head stays as it was.

Only the first match is removed: the function returns as soon as it has made one change. If the loop runs off the end without a match, the list is handed back untouched. This is the same behaviour as list.remove, except that list.remove raises ValueError when the value is missing, and this version does nothing.
The skipped node is not destroyed here. Nothing refers to it any more, so Python frees it by itself.
zh: 节点没法把自己摘下来：它没有指向前一个节点的引用。删除 current，就是去改 current 前面那个节点的 next，让它跳过 current。所以走链表时要带两个变量 prev 与 current，prev 永远落后一个节点。一开始后面还没有节点，prev 是 None。
如果第一个节点就对上了，prev 还是 None，没有前一个节点可改——要去掉的就是头本身。函数把它后面那个节点当新的头交回去；链表原来只有一个节点时，交回的是 None。否则就让 prev 的链接跳过 current，头保持不变。
只删第一个对上的：做完一次改动函数就返回。循环一直走出链尾都没找到，链表原样交回。这和 list.remove 的行为一样，只是 list.remove 找不到时会抛 ValueError，这一版什么也不做。
被跳过的节点在这里并没有被销毁。已经没有任何东西引用它，Python 会自己把它回收。

lineNotes.en: Building from the back: each new node goes in front of the ones already made, so walking the values backwards leaves them in their original order. reversed does not change the list it is given.
lineNotes.zh: 从后往前建：每个新节点都放在已经造好的那些前面，所以倒着取值，最后的顺序正好是原来的顺序。reversed 不会改动传给它的列表。

lineNotes.en: Deleting the head: the new head is whatever came after it.
lineNotes.zh: 删的是头：新的头就是原来跟在它后面的那个。

title.en: Reverse a Linked List with Three Pointers

blurb.en: No new nodes and no copy of the values: walk the chain once and turn every next pointer round to face the other way.
blurb.zh: 不造新节点，也不复制值：沿着链走一遍，把每根 next 指针都掉个头。

en: The nodes stay where they are and keep their values; only the links change direction. When the loop is done, the old last node is the new head and the old head points at None.

Three variables do the work. current is the node being turned round. prev is the node it should point back at - None at first, because the old head becomes the new tail. The third one exists for one reason: the moment current's next is changed, the only reference to the rest of the chain is gone. So it has to be saved first, and the loop moves on to the saved node, not to current's next.

Each pass turns exactly one link, then shifts prev and current one node along. Because every step only looks at nodes that are already held in variables, the list of a thousand nodes needs no more memory than the list of three. Compare the title Reverse a Linked List Recursively, which solves the same problem by calling itself.
zh: 节点待在原地、值也不变，变的只是链接的方向。循环结束时，原来的最后一个节点成了新的头，原来的头指向 None。
三个变量分工。current 是正在掉头的节点。prev 是它该回头指向的节点——一开始是 None，因为原来的头要变成新的尾。第三个变量只为一件事存在：current 的 next 一改，指向后半条链的唯一引用就没了。所以得先把它存起来，循环往前挪也是挪到存下的那个节点，而不是 current 的 next。
每一轮只掉头一根链接，然后 prev 与 current 一起往前挪一个节点。每一步只碰已经存在变量里的节点，所以一千个节点的链表和三个节点的一样，不需要多用内存。对照「递归反转链表」，它用调用自己来解同一个问题。

lineNotes.en: The old head will be the new tail, and a tail points at None - so None is the first thing anything points back at.
lineNotes.zh: 原来的头会变成新的尾，而尾指向 None——所以第一个被回头指着的就是 None。

lineNotes.en: The entry takes plain values, builds its own list, reverses it and turns it back into a Python list. The list it was given is never touched.
lineNotes.zh: 入口收的是普通值，自己建链表、反转、再转回 Python 列表。传进来的列表始终没被碰过。

blurb.en: Reverse everything after the head, then hang the head on the end of what comes back.
blurb.zh: 先反转头后面的全部，再把头挂到反转结果的末尾。

en: Recursion itself is covered on the Recursion page; this note is only about what it does to a linked list.

A list that is empty or has one node is already its own reverse, so it is returned as it is. For anything longer, reverse is called on the part after the head. Trust it to do its job: it hands back the head of that part reversed - the old last node - and that is also the head of the whole answer, so it is passed straight back up at the end.

What is left is the head itself. After the rest has been reversed, the node that used to come second is now the last node of the reversed part, and the head still points at it. So the head is attached after that node, and then the head's own link is cut, because the head is now the tail. Cut the link first and there is no way left to reach that node.

Every node gets one call, and each call waits for the one after it, so a very long list hits Python's limit on nested calls. The title Reverse a Linked List with Three Pointers does the same job with a loop and has no such limit.
zh: 递归本身见「递归」一页；这里只讲它在链表上做了什么。
空链表或只有一个节点的链表，反转后还是它自己，原样交回。更长的，就对头后面那一段调用 reverse。信任它会把活干好：它交回那一段反转后的头——也就是原来的最后一个节点——而这也正是整个答案的头，所以最后原样往上交回去。
剩下的就是头本身。后面那段反转之后，原来排第二的节点成了反转部分的最后一个节点，而头仍然指着它。所以把头挂在那个节点后面，再切断头自己往后的链接，因为头现在是尾了。先切断链接的话，就再也找不到那个节点了。
每个节点一次调用，每次调用都要等后面那一次返回，所以很长的链表会撞上 Python 对嵌套调用层数的上限。「三指针反转链表」用循环做同一件事，没有这个限制。

lineNotes.at: if head is None or head.next is None:
lineNotes.en: Two lists that need no work: no nodes at all, or exactly one node.
lineNotes.zh: 两种不用干活的链表：一个节点都没有，或者正好一个节点。

lineNotes.en: The same new head travels all the way back up: every call returns the old last node.
lineNotes.zh: 同一个新头一路往上传：每一层调用交回的都是原来的最后一个节点。

blurb.en: Each node points forwards and backwards, so the list can be walked both ways - and every insert or delete has to keep both directions right.
blurb.zh: 每个节点既往后指、也往前指，于是链表两头都能走——每次插入或删除都得让两个方向都对。

en: A node now has two links: next to the node after it and prev to the node before it. That is what makes the backward walk possible, and it is also what makes deleting easier: a node can reach its own neighbour in front without anyone walking behind it.

The list has one extra node that holds no value, called a sentinel. It sits at both ends at once: its next is the first real node and its prev is the last. An empty list is the sentinel pointing at itself both ways. Because every real node always has a node on each side - even if that node is the sentinel - insert and remove never need a special case for the front, the back or an empty list. Walks start just past the sentinel and stop when they come back round to it.

Inserting between before and after changes four links: the new node's two, then one on each neighbour. Because before and after are both held in variables, no order of those four can lose a node. Removing changes two: the neighbours on either side of the node are joined to each other, which leaves the node out of both directions at once.
An index past the end inserts at the back, as list.insert does; remove takes out the first match and does nothing if there is none.
zh: 节点现在有两个链接：next 指向后一个节点，prev 指向前一个节点。这让倒着走成为可能，也让删除更容易：节点自己就能找到前面的邻居，不用另找一个指针跟在后面。
链表多了一个不装值的节点，叫哨兵（sentinel）。它同时守在两端：它的 next 是第一个真节点，它的 prev 是最后一个真节点。空链表就是哨兵的两个方向都指着自己。因为每个真节点两边永远都有节点——哪怕那个节点是哨兵——插入和删除都不用为表头、表尾或空表单独写特例。两个方向的遍历都从哨兵旁边出发，绕回哨兵就停。
在 before 与 after 之间插入要改四根链接：新节点自己的两根，再加两个邻居各一根。before 与 after 都已经存在变量里，所以这四根怎么排先后都不会弄丢节点。删除改两根：把节点两侧的邻居互相连上，节点就同时从两个方向上消失了。
下标超过末尾时插到最后，与 list.insert 相同；remove 删第一个对上的，找不到什么也不做。

lineNotes.en: An empty list: the sentinel is its own neighbour in both directions.
lineNotes.zh: 空链表：哨兵在两个方向上的邻居都是它自己。

lineNotes.at: while i > 0 and after is not self.sentinel:
lineNotes.en: Walk i nodes along, but stop if the walk comes back round to the sentinel - that is the end of the list.
lineNotes.zh: 往前走 i 个节点，但如果绕回了哨兵就停——那就是链表的末尾。

lineNotes.en: The node that will sit in front of the new one. When after is the sentinel, this is the last real node - or the sentinel itself if the list is empty.
lineNotes.zh: 将要排在新节点前面的那个节点。after 是哨兵时，它是最后一个真节点——链表为空时就是哨兵本身。

blurb.en: Push puts a new node in front of the head, pop takes the head away: the front of a linked list is a ready-made stack top.
blurb.zh: push 在头前面放一个新节点，pop 把头拿走：链表的最前端天生就是栈顶。

en: A stack only ever touches one end, and a singly linked list has one end that is easy to reach: the head. So the head is the top. Each node points down to the node underneath it, and the bottom node points at None.

push makes a new node that points at the current top and then makes it the top. pop remembers the top node's value, moves the top down to the node underneath, and returns the remembered value. Neither of them walks the list: however many items are on the stack, each call changes just the top.

Popping or peeking at an empty stack returns None here instead of raising an error; is_empty is the check a caller would use before popping. Unlike an array-based stack there is no capacity, so there is no full stack - a push can always make one more node.
zh: 栈只碰一端，而单向链表正好有一端很容易够到：头。所以头就是栈顶。每个节点往下指着它下面那个节点，最底下的节点指向 None。
push 造一个指向当前栈顶的新节点，再把它设成栈顶。pop 记下栈顶节点的值，让栈顶挪到下面那个节点，然后交回记下的值。两个都不用沿着链表走：栈里不管有多少东西，每次调用都只动栈顶。
空栈上 pop 或 peek，这里返回 None 而不是抛错；调用者 pop 之前可以先用 is_empty 查一下。和用数组做的栈不同，它没有容量，所以没有「栈满」——push 总能再造一个节点。

lineNotes.en: An empty stack has no top node at all.
lineNotes.zh: 空栈连一个栈顶节点都没有。

lineNotes.en: Any other operation is a peek. Only pop and peek give back a value, so only they add to results.
lineNotes.zh: 其余的操作都是 peek。只有 pop 与 peek 交回值，所以只有它们往 results 里加东西。

title.en: A Linked List in Two Arrays

blurb.en: No node objects at all: one array holds the values, a parallel array holds the pointers, and unused cells form a second chain called the free list.
blurb.zh: 一个节点对象都没有：一个数组装值，一个平行数组装指针，没用上的格子自己连成第二条链，叫空闲链。

en: This is how exam pseudocode describes a linked list. A pointer is simply an index into the arrays: data[k] is the value in cell k and next_ptr[k] is the index of the cell that comes after it. NULL, written as -1 because no cell has that index, plays the part that None plays for node objects. start is the index of the first cell of the list.

At the beginning every cell is unused, and the unused cells are chained together too: free is the first unused cell, and next_ptr leads from each one to the next. To add an item, insert takes the cell at the front of the free list and moves free on to the cell after it. When free is NULL, every cell is in use and the list is full.

The list is kept in alphabetical order. The loop walks prev and current along the list until current reaches an item that should come after the new one. The new cell then points at current, and whatever pointed at current - start, or the cell prev - now points at the new cell. The same two steps as inserting a node object, written with indexes.

insert changes start and free, which live outside the function, so it has to declare them global; without that line, assigning to them would create new local variables instead. data and next_ptr need no declaration, because the function changes what is inside those lists without ever assigning a new list to the names.
zh: 考卷的伪代码就是这样描述链表的。指针就是一个数组下标：data[k] 是第 k 格里的值，next_ptr[k] 是排在它后面那一格的下标。NULL 写成 -1，因为没有哪一格的下标是 -1，它起的作用就是节点对象那边 None 的作用。start 是链表第一格的下标。
一开始每一格都没用上，而没用上的格子也连成一条链：free 是第一个空闲格，next_ptr 从每个空闲格指向下一个。要加一个值，insert 就从空闲链的最前面取一格，再让 free 挪到它后面那一格。free 是 NULL 时，每一格都用上了，链表满了。
链表按字母顺序排着。循环让 prev 与 current 沿链表往前走，直到 current 碰到一个应该排在新值后面的值。然后新格子指向 current，原来指向 current 的那一个——start，或者 prev 那一格——改指向新格子。和插入节点对象是同样的两步，只是用下标写出来。
insert 要改 start 与 free，而它们在函数外面，所以得声明 global；没有这一行，给它们赋值只会造出两个新的局部变量。data 与 next_ptr 不用声明，因为函数只改这两个列表里面的东西，从来没有把一个新列表赋给这两个名字。

lineNotes.en: At the start this array is the free list: cell 0 leads to 1, 1 to 2, and so on, and the last cell leads nowhere.
lineNotes.zh: 一开始这个数组就是空闲链：第 0 格指向 1，1 指向 2，依此类推，最后一格哪儿也不指。

lineNotes.en: Both names are assigned below, so without this line Python would treat them as local to insert.
lineNotes.zh: 下面要给这两个名字赋值；没有这一行，Python 会把它们当成 insert 自己的局部变量。

lineNotes.at: while current != NULL and data[current] < item:
lineNotes.en: Strings compare alphabetically. The check for NULL comes first, so data[-1] is never looked at.
lineNotes.zh: 字符串按字母顺序比较。先查 NULL，于是 data[-1] 永远不会被读到。

lineNotes.en: The array order is the order items arrived in, not the list order. Only start and next_ptr know the list order.
lineNotes.zh: 数组里的顺序是值到来的先后，不是链表的顺序。链表的顺序只有 start 与 next_ptr 知道。

run.expect:
apple -> fig -> pear -> plum
start = 1 free = 4
['pear', 'apple', 'plum', 'fig', '']
[2, 3, -1, 0, -1]
List full, cannot add lime
apple -> fig -> kiwi -> pear -> plum

title.en: A Linked List That Works with for and len
title.zh: 能用 for 与 len 的链表

blurb.en: Three special methods, and a home-made linked list works with for, list(), in, len() and print just like a built-in container.
blurb.zh: 三个特殊方法，自己写的链表就能像内置容器一样用 for、list()、in、len() 与 print。

en: A for loop does not know about linked lists. What it does is call iter() on the object, which calls the object's __iter__ method, and then keep asking the result for its next value until it is told there are none left. So a class only has to provide __iter__, and for, list(), in and unpacking all start working with it.

The simplest way to write __iter__ is with yield. Any function whose body contains yield is a generator function, and calling it does not run the body at all: it hands back a generator object. Each time that generator is asked for a value, the body runs from where it last stopped up to the next yield, hands out the value after yield, and pauses there - its local variables, current included, stay exactly as they were. When the body finally ends, the generator reports that it has no more values and the for loop stops. That is how one call to __iter__ can give out the values one at a time, walking the list only as far as it is asked to.

The last line of the main block shows the machinery directly: iter() gets a fresh generator, and each next() runs it to the following yield. A second call to iter() would start a new walk from the head.

__len__ is what len() calls. The list keeps count as items are added, so the answer needs no walk. __repr__ is what print uses when a class has no __str__; it builds its text from list(self), which is the generator at work again.
zh: for 循环并不认识链表。它做的是对这个对象调用 iter()，iter() 再去调对象的 __iter__ 方法，然后不停地向得到的结果要下一个值，直到被告知没有了。所以一个类只要提供 __iter__，for、list()、in 和拆包就全都能用。

写 __iter__ 最简单的办法是用 yield。函数体里只要出现 yield，它就是一个生成器函数，调用它时函数体根本不执行：交回来的是一个生成器对象。每次向这个生成器要一个值，函数体就从上次停下的地方接着跑，跑到下一个 yield，把 yield 后面的值交出去，然后停在那里——局部变量（包括 current）原封不动地保留着。函数体最终跑完时，生成器报告没有值了，for 循环就停下。所以一次 __iter__ 调用能一个一个地交出值，而且只在被要求时才沿着链表往前走。
主程序最后一行把这套机制直接摆出来：iter() 拿到一个新的生成器，每次 next() 把它推到下一个 yield。再调一次 iter() 会从头开始一次新的遍历。
__len__ 是 len() 调用的方法。链表在添加时一路记着个数，所以答案不用走一遍。类里没有 __str__ 时，print 用的是 __repr__；它用 list(self) 拼出文字——这又是生成器在干活。

lineNotes.en: push_front adds at the front, so the values are added back to front to keep their order. list() first, because values could be any iterable and reversed needs a sequence.
lineNotes.zh: push_front 往最前面加，所以倒着加，顺序才保持不变。先套 list()，因为 values 可以是任何可迭代对象，而 reversed 要的是序列。

lineNotes.en: list(self) walks the linked list through __iter__; repr of that Python list supplies the brackets and quotes.
lineNotes.zh: list(self) 经由 __iter__ 走一遍链表；对得到的 Python 列表取 repr，方括号和引号就都有了。

lineNotes.en: There is no __contains__ method, so in falls back on __iter__ and compares the values one by one.
lineNotes.zh: 类里没有 __contains__ 方法，于是 in 退而用 __iter__，逐个比较值。

lineNotes.en: A generator object. Nothing in __iter__ has run yet.
lineNotes.zh: 一个生成器对象。__iter__ 里的代码此刻还一行都没跑。

eggs
milk

['eggs', 'milk', 'tea']
True
LinkedList(['jam', 'eggs', 'milk', 'tea'])

blurb.en: The same six letters in a linked list and in a Python list: count the steps it takes to reach item 4, and see what moves when something is added at the front.
blurb.zh: 同样六个字母，一份放链表、一份放 Python 列表：数一数走到第 4 项要几步，再看往最前面加一项时谁要挪动。

en: A linked list has no way to jump to item i. The only way in is the head, so get_at starts there and follows next i times, counting as it goes. Reaching item 4 takes 4 steps. A Python list keeps its items side by side in one block, so letters[4] goes straight to the right place in a single step.

Adding at the front turns the comparison round. push_front makes one new node that points at the old head, and no existing node is touched. list.insert(0, ...) has to shift every item already in the list one place along to open a gap at position 0 - six moves for this list, and more the longer the list is.

Neither is better in general: it depends on which operation a program does most. This page only counts the steps for one example; measuring how the counts grow with the size of the data belongs to the analysis of algorithms.
zh: 链表没办法直接跳到第 i 项。唯一的入口是头，所以 get_at 从头出发、顺着 next 走 i 次，边走边数。到第 4 项要走 4 步。Python 列表把各项挨着放在一整块里，所以 letters[4] 一步就到了正确的位置。
往最前面加东西，对比就反过来了。push_front 只造一个指向原来头的新节点，已有的节点一个都不碰。list.insert(0, ...) 得把列表里已有的每一项都往后挪一格，才能在位置 0 腾出空位——这个列表要挪六次，列表越长挪得越多。
两者没有哪个总是更好：看程序最常做的是哪种操作。这一页只数一个例子里走了几步；步数随数据规模怎么增长的测量，属于算法分析。

lineNotes.en: Two things come back as a tuple: the value found and how many steps it took.
lineNotes.zh: 以元组交回两样东西：找到的值，以及走了几步。

lineNotes.en: Every item already in the list moves one place along to make room.
lineNotes.zh: 列表里已有的每一项都往后挪一格来腾地方。

lineNotes.en: Item 0 is the head itself: zero steps.
lineNotes.zh: 第 0 项就是头本身：零步。
